items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...campaign for Nixon and Ford... [INTERVIEWEE] He's Rockefeller's man.

ctx.x: And during the '20s and '30s, strikers at Ford Motor Car Company and other places like that were brutally beaten and shot to death and arrested and never heard of again.
Well, Ford was with the Nazis, wasn't he?
